topic: jubo dal leader found dead in bandarban
headline_marked: [[Jubo Dal leader found dead]] in Bandarban stream
headline: Jubo Dal leader found dead in Bandarban stream
summary: Md Sharif, 33, was the joint convener of the Talukdar Para block. Police report injury marks on the body.
details: The body of Md Sharif, a local leader of the Jatiyatabadi Jubo Dal, was recovered from a hilly stream in the Kasai Para area of Bandarban town yesterday morning.
Sharif, 33, served as the joint convener of the Talukdar Para block under Ward-9 of the Bandarban municipality unit of the party's youth wing.
The body was discovered around 10:00 am by local women collecting water from a stream located beside the Bandarban-Chattogram road, near the bus terminal.
Police and fire service personnel recovered the body after receiving information from locals.
Mohammad Arif, president of the Bandarban municipality Jubo Dal unit, confirmed the identification of Sharif after the recovery.
Masud Parvez, officer-in-charge of Bandarban Sadar Police Station, stated that there were injury marks on Sharif's hands, legs, and head, as well as bleeding from the nose and mouth.
Authorities are investigating whether Sharif fell accidentally or was pushed down the hill.
caption:

headline_marked: Over 50 blasts, [[8 buses torched in Dhaka]]
headline: Over 50 blasts, 8 buses torched in Dhaka
summary: A wave of violence and arsony in the capital city has left the city in terror, with multiple vehicles burned and numerous explosions reported.
details: More than 50 explosions were reported across Dhaka, creating a widespread sense of panic among the city's residents.
In addition to the blasts, at least 8 buses were set on fire, causing significant property damage and disrupting transportation in the capital.
The incidents occurred in various parts of the city, targeting vehicles and public spaces, leading to a a high state of alert for security forces.
Authorities are currently investigating the perpetrators behind these coordinated attacks to identify those responsible for the violence.
The city remains on high alert as security forces have increased their patrols to prevent further incidents of arson and explosions.
